boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other

cards.title: Fireside Lounge

cards.title: Bello Center Reading Room

cards.title: Interfaith Meditation Room

cards.title: AIC Breakout Rooms

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover the best free social and recreational spots at Bryant University, from scenic nature trails and historic campus landmarks to student-only wellness facilities and study hubs.

cards.title: Hike the Campus Perimeter
cards.subtitle: A 1.3-mile wooded loop
cards.notes: Walk the 1.3-mile paved and wooded trail behind the Unistructure to unwind in nature. It is open to the public and students for hiking or quiet reflection.
cards.short_summary: A 1.3-mile scenic walking and running loop through the wooded areas of the Bryant campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bryant walking trail is a 1.3-mile route located behind the Unistructure that is free and open to students and visitors.
cards.source_title: Elevate your outdoor activity on campus with these 8 recreational pastimes

cards.title: Study at the Information Hub
cards.subtitle: Academic resources and quiet space
cards.notes: Access thousands of resources or book a group study room for free. Smithfield residents can also obtain a courtesy card to borrow materials at no cost.
cards.short_summary: The primary university library offering study spaces, 3D printers, and community access for Smithfield residents.
cards.evidence_claim: Residents of Smithfield may receive, at no cost, privileges at the Douglas and Judith Krupp Library, including borrowing up to ten materials.
cards.source_title: Access Policy for Guests of Bryant University
cards.access_notes: Open to students with ID; Smithfield residents 18+ can visit for free with ID.

cards.title: Work Out at the Chace Center
cards.subtitle: Fitness and aquatic facilities
cards.notes: Use the fitness center, six-lane pool, or racquetball courts. These facilities are free for all Bryant students to maintain physical wellbeing.
cards.short_summary: A comprehensive athletic complex featuring a pool, fitness center, and courts available to the student body.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chace Wellness Center's facilities, including the pool and fitness center, are open to all Bryant students.
cards.source_title: Physical Wellbeing - Bryant University
cards.access_notes: Student ID required for entry; hours vary by semester and academic calendar.

cards.title: Relax in the Fireside Lounge
cards.subtitle: The campus living room
cards.notes: Hang out by the fireplace or play a game of ping pong. The center serves as a free social hub for student organizations and casual gatherings.
cards.short_summary: The central social hub of campus featuring lounges, meeting rooms, and recreational equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fisher Student Center provides facilities and programs for the use of Bryant students, including a fireside lounge and ping pong.
cards.source_title: Fisher Student Center - Information Directory
cards.access_notes: Open daily; late-night hours typically available during the academic semester.

cards.title: Visit the Tupper Statue
cards.subtitle: A tribute to the mascot

cards.evidence_claim: The life-size golden bulldog statue is currently housed in the Bulldog Room of the Elizabeth and Malcolm Chace Wellness and Athletic Center.
cards.source_title: Step inside the archives: A peek into a handful of Bryant's timeless artifacts
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Chace Wellness Center; accessible during building operating hours.

cards.title: Cast a Line at the Pond
cards.subtitle: Recreational fishing on campus
cards.notes: Enjoy catch-and-release fishing at the campus pond. It is a popular spot for students to relax outdoors without leaving the university grounds.
cards.short_summary: The central campus pond used for recreational fishing and community traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: Students can cast a line into Bryant's pond as one of the free recreational pastimes available on campus.
cards.source_title: Elevate your outdoor activity on campus with these 8 recreational pastimes
cards.access_notes: Open to the campus community; catch-and-release fishing is encouraged.

cards.title: Attend a Global Community Hour
cards.subtitle: Cultural exchange and connection
cards.notes: Join free events like Global Community Hour to learn about different cultures. The center provides a supportive space for international and domestic students.
cards.short_summary: A campus center hosting free cultural heritage celebrations and leadership programs like 4MILE.
cards.evidence_claim: The Intercultural Center (ICC) organizes free programs including Global Community Hour and Celebration of Heritage Months.
cards.source_title: Intercultural Center - Information Directory
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of the Fisher Student Center; open to all students.

cards.title: Run the Eight-Lane Track
cards.subtitle: Outdoor fitness for all

cards.evidence_claim: The eight-lane track is open to students, faculty, and staff except during practices and competitions.

cards.title: Visit the Campus Dog Park

cards.short_summary: A public dog park located on the Bryant University campus grounds for local and student use.
cards.evidence_claim: Local residents and students enjoy access to the dog park at the edge of the Bryant University campus.

cards.title: Collaborate in the AIC

cards.evidence_claim: Students can book breakout rooms in the AIC or other space resources like 3D Printers at no cost.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and hallowed traditions that define the Bulldog spirit at Bryant University, from superstitions involving the historic Archway to the annual Festival of Lights.

cards.title: The Archway Superstition
cards.subtitle: A walk to avoid until graduation
cards.notes: Students avoid walking under this wrought-iron gate until Commencement; legend says passing through early prevents graduation.
cards.short_summary: A campus superstition where students avoid walking through the historic iron archway until their graduation day.
cards.evidence_claim: The legend goes that students who walk through the Archway before graduating will not graduate. Students walk through the Archway during Commencement to signify their graduation.
cards.source_title: Exploring campus legends, landmarks, and little-known lore | Bryant News
cards.access_notes: Located outdoors in the center of the Smithfield campus; accessible to the public.

cards.title: Festival of Lights
cards.subtitle: A multi-faith winter celebration
cards.notes: Join the community in the Koffler Rotunda for a candle-lighting ceremony celebrating global holiday traditions and unity.
cards.short_summary: One of Bryant's oldest traditions, this December event features a candle-lighting ceremony and multi-faith holiday celebrations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Festival, now in its 49th year, is one of Bryant's oldest and most hallowed traditions... culminating with a traditional lighting of candles in the University Rotunda.
cards.source_title: 49th Festival of Lights celebrates the power of tradition, community, and connection
cards.access_notes: Held annually in December inside the Unistructure's Koffler Rotunda.

cards.title: Meeting Tupper the Bulldog
cards.subtitle: The live mascot tradition
cards.notes: Look for the university's live English Bulldog mascot at athletic games and campus events for a photo and a greeting.
cards.short_summary: Bryant maintains a tradition of a live English Bulldog mascot, named Tupper, who attends major campus and sporting events.
cards.evidence_claim: Tupper II will officially retire this December after an amazing eight years... A search is currently underway to identify the next live mascot, Tupper III.
cards.source_title: BRYANT UNIVERSITY MASCOT TUPPER II SET TO RETIRE
cards.access_notes: Tupper appears at various campus locations and athletic venues like the Chace Athletic Center.

cards.title: The Annual Duck Race
cards.subtitle: Rubber ducks for a cause
cards.notes: Watch hundreds of rubber ducks race across the pond during Family and Friends Weekend to raise funds for the senior class.
cards.short_summary: A fundraising tradition where rubber ducks are raced across Bryant Pond during the annual Family and Friends Weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: For the 27th year, the annual Duck Race took place on the Bryant pond... The event raised more than $4,000 toward the Class of 2021's Senior Week.
cards.source_title: Family and Friends Weekend highlights fall accomplishments - Bryant News
cards.access_notes: Takes place at the pond in the center of campus during Family and Friends Weekend in October.

cards.title: Midnight Madness
cards.subtitle: Kicking off basketball season
cards.notes: Experience the high-energy introduction of the men's and women's basketball teams with performances by the pep band and dance team.
cards.short_summary: An annual late-night event at the Chace Athletic Center to celebrate the start of the NCAA basketball season.
cards.evidence_claim: Every year, our team looks forward to the kick off of basketball season with Midnight Madness... the band led the audience in the official release of the Bryant University Fight Song.
cards.source_title: Midnight Madness and the New Bryant Fight Song!
cards.access_notes: Held at the Chace Athletic Center; typically occurs in late October or early November.

cards.title: Big Bingo Nights
cards.subtitle: High-stakes student gaming
cards.notes: Compete for major prizes like electronics and gift cards at these popular monthly bingo events hosted by the Student Programming Board.
cards.short_summary: A staple of Bryant student life, Big Bingo features large crowds and significant prizes in the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: From the welcoming Big B Weekend to Spring Weekend... to the monthly Big Bingos, and many other major events, SPB hosts activities on and off campus.
cards.source_title: Clubs and Organizations | Bryant University
cards.access_notes: Usually held in the Fisher Student Center or the Unistructure; open to all undergraduate students.

cards.title: Spring Weekend
cards.subtitle: The year-end festival
cards.notes: Celebrate the end of the academic year with a major outdoor concert, food trucks, and themed activities across campus.
cards.short_summary: Bryant's signature spring festival featuring a large-scale concert and various social events for the student body.
cards.evidence_claim: Join Bryant's Student Programming Board for its annual food truck festival leading up to the annual spring concert... stay up to date on these Spring Weekend events.
cards.source_title: The ultimate bucket list for Bryant seniors
cards.access_notes: Events are spread across campus, with the main concert often held at Beirne Stadium or the Chace Center.

cards.title: Senior Class Toast
cards.subtitle: A final cheers to the class
cards.notes: Gather with fellow seniors during Commencement Week for a formal toast to celebrate your transition from students to alumni.
cards.short_summary: A celebratory event for graduating seniors to toast their achievements before the formal Commencement ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: The week begins with the Senior Class Toast, followed by the Multicultural Student Services Center (MSSC) Graduation Celebration.
cards.source_title: Ceremony & Speakers | Commencement - Bryant University
cards.access_notes: Exclusive to graduating seniors; held during Commencement Week in May.

cards.title: The Golden Bulldog
cards.subtitle: A symbol of senior legacy
cards.notes: Visit the life-size golden statue of Tupper, a gift from the Class of 1999, located in the Chace Wellness Center.
cards.short_summary: A 125-pound golden statue of the university mascot, gifted by seniors to represent the 'Character of Success'.
cards.evidence_claim: Golden Bulldog: Seniors gifted a golden bulldog to the university in 1999. The life-size representation of Tupper... is currently housed in the Bulldog Room.
cards.source_title: Step inside the archives: A peek into a handful of Bryant's timeless artifacts
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Elizabeth and Malcolm Chace Wellness and Athletic Center.

cards.title: The Birthday Pond Plunge
cards.subtitle: A wet birthday surprise
cards.notes: Beware the tradition of being 'tossed' into the campus pond by friends on your birthday, regardless of the weather.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing, unofficial student tradition of throwing peers into Bryant Pond to celebrate their birthdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Being thrown into the pond for your birthday or taking a dip prior to graduation were time-honored traditions... regardless the temperature of time of year.
cards.source_title: Once Upon(d) a Time: A reflection on Bryant Pond
cards.access_notes: An informal tradition occurring at the campus pond throughout the academic year.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Bryant University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A guide for new Bulldogs to navigate their first weekend on campus, from essential traditions to late-night bites.

cards.title: Walk Around the Archway
cards.subtitle: A Superstitious First Step
cards.notes: Avoid walking through the Archway until graduation day; legend says those who pass under it early won't graduate. Use the brick path to walk around it.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus landmark central to Bryant's most famous student superstition.
cards.evidence_claim: Tradition dictates that passing through the archway before Commencement is bad luck, and legend has it that students who walk through it beforehand will not graduate.
cards.source_title: Mission & History | Bryant University
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 as a central campus landmark.

cards.title: Lunch at 'Salmo'
cards.subtitle: The Main Campus Hub
cards.notes: Grab a meal at the central dining hall in the Unistructure. It features various stations including a pizza oven and global comfort foods.
cards.short_summary: The primary all-you-care-to-eat dining facility for Bryant students.
cards.evidence_claim: Salmanson Dining Hall, or 'Salmo,' is the central dining hall on Tupper Campus located in the Unistructure.
cards.source_title: Salmanson Dining Hall | Information Directory - Bryant University
cards.access_notes: Open daily; weekend hours are typically 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

cards.title: Play Ping Pong at Fisher
cards.subtitle: Socialize in the Student Hub
cards.notes: Head to the Fisher Student Center to meet peers over a game of ping pong or gather for group projects in the lounge areas.
cards.short_summary: The social heart of campus offering facilities for recreation and student organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: Fisher Student Center provides facilities for gathering with friends over a game of ping pong and student organization meetings.
cards.source_title: Fisher Student Center - Information Directory - Bryant University
cards.access_notes: Central hub for student activities; hours vary by semester.

cards.title: Visit the Golden Bulldog
cards.subtitle: A Mascot Landmark
cards.notes: Find the life-size golden statue of Tupper, the university mascot, located in the Chace Wellness and Athletic Center.
cards.short_summary: A 125-pound golden representation of Bryant's beloved mascot, Tupper.
cards.evidence_claim: The life-size representation of Tupper, Bryant's beloved mascot, is currently housed in the Bulldog Room of the Chace Wellness and Athletic Center.
cards.source_title: Step inside the archives: A peek into a handful of Bryant's timeless artifacts
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Chace Wellness Center operating hours.

cards.title: Work Out at the Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Stay Active on Campus
cards.notes: Visit the second-floor fitness center for a workout. Check the schedule for open gym and pool hours during your first weekend.
cards.short_summary: The primary athletic and recreation facility for the Bryant community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Elizabeth and Malcolm Chace Wellness and Athletic Center is the campus home for Bryant athletics and fitness.
cards.source_title: Chace Wellness Center - Information Directory - Bryant University
cards.access_notes: Weekend hours are typically Saturday 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM.

cards.title: Late Night Pizza at Ronzio
cards.subtitle: A Newport House Staple
cards.notes: Located on the ground floor of Newport House, this is a go-to spot for students craving pizza late into the evening.
cards.short_summary: A popular on-campus pizza shop located within a residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Ronzio is located on the ground floor of Newport House and is a recognized dining option for students.
cards.source_title: Dining - Information Directory - Bryant University
cards.access_notes: Located in Newport House; typically open for late-night service.

cards.title: Cheer at a Football Game
cards.subtitle: Bulldog Spirit
cards.notes: Experience the energy of a home game at Beirne Stadium. It's a central part of the fall weekend experience for new students.
cards.short_summary: The home field for Bryant Bulldogs football and a hub for school spirit.
cards.evidence_claim: Beirne Stadium is the site for major campus events including football games and Convocation.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Bryant University
cards.access_notes: Open during scheduled athletic events and ceremonies.

cards.title: Get Your Bulldog Gear
cards.subtitle: Fisher Student Center, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Pick up Bryant apparel and essentials at the bookstore to show your school pride during your first weekend events.
cards.short_summary: The official campus store for textbooks, supplies, and Bryant-branded merchandise.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Bookstore is located on the 2nd floor of the Fisher Student Center.
cards.source_title: Campus Amenities - Information Directory - Bryant University
cards.access_notes: Open during standard business hours; check for special weekend hours during Welcome Week.

cards.title: Explore the Library
cards.subtitle: Academic Preparation
cards.notes: Locate your favorite study spot in the Krupp Library before classes start. It's a quiet space to organize your first-week schedule.
cards.short_summary: The main academic library providing research resources and diverse study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Douglas and Judith Krupp Library is a key academic resource on campus.
cards.source_title: Campus Amenities - Information Directory - Bryant University
cards.access_notes: Hours vary; check the library website for current weekend operating times.

cards.title: Grab a Burger at B'z
cards.subtitle: A Local Student Favorite
cards.notes: Take a short trip down Douglas Pike to B'z for a burger. It's a well-known off-campus spot for Bryant students.
cards.short_summary: A popular local eatery near campus known for breakfast and burgers.
cards.evidence_claim: Bz is less than 3 minutes from Bryant and is a go-to stop for students.
cards.source_title: 25 Places I Wish I Knew About As a Freshman at Bryant - Spoon University
cards.access_notes: Located at 970 Douglas Pike, Smithfield.
